intent.summary: Add a Wizard panel and support importing custom scrapper.yml files, stored locally and taking precedence over built-in scrapers.
intent.whyNow: We need a faster, iteration-friendly path to support list/card-based pages (CNKI / Scholar / PubMed) without requiring a rebuild for each selector tweak.
nonGoals: No full AI selector generation pipeline in this milestone (only availability placeholder)
No online editing/enable-disable UI for imported scrapers

decisions.title: Custom scraper precedence
decisions.rationale: Custom scrapers are used to iterate quickly; they must override built-in rules when they match.

decisions.title: Ordering among multiple matching custom scrapers
decisions.rationale: Users typically import updated YAML to override prior versions.

decisions.title: Storage location/key
decisions.rationale: Small metadata and YAML text; local storage is simplest and sufficient for M1.
